title: Console backend APIs for route-level A/B experiment CRUD + lifecycle (validate/start/stop/rollback)
creator: Dylan Brooks
description:
Implement the Console control-plane API surface for Route-level A/B testing experiments. Includes: CRUD endpoints, server-side validation, lifecycle transitions (start/stop/pause/rollback), authz checks, and emitting audit log events for all changes.

This issue covers the Console backend service + config persistence layer. It does NOT cover telemetry aggregation or dashboard queries (see ENG-2844/ENG-2845) and does NOT implement assignment logic in the data-plane (see ENG-2841 / gateway emission PRs).

Primary users: Console UI (create/validate/start/stop/rollback flows) + internal tooling (support/SRE) for emergency rollback.

Owners/partners:
- Primary: Chloe Martin
- Routing/Policy: Jordan Lee, Mina Haddad (review)
- Security/Audit: Marcus Lin, Kevin Osei (review)
- Product: Marissa Cole (API behavior + UX alignment)

References:
- Confluence PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/prd-route-level-ab-testing-framework.json
- Console workflows spec: sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/console-route-ab-testing-workflows.json
- ADR precedence/determinism: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-0187-deterministic-ab-assignment-at-route-level.json
- Audit events spec: sources/confluence/security-and-compliance/audit-logging/ab-testing-audit-events.json
acceptance_criteria:
API endpoints
- [x] POST /console/v1/experiments (create draft)
- [x] GET /console/v1/experiments/{id}
- [x] LIST /console/v1/experiments?project_id=&status=&route_id=
- [x] PATCH /console/v1/experiments/{id} (update draft fields only)
- [x] POST /console/v1/experiments/{id}:validate (returns normalized config + errors/warnings)
- [x] POST /console/v1/experiments/{id}:start (transition draft|paused -> running)
- [x] POST /console/v1/experiments/{id}:stop (transition running -> stopped; retains results)
- [x] POST /console/v1/experiments/{id}:rollback (fast path to restore pre-experiment routing policy)
- [ ] (Optional, if needed by UI copy) POST /console/v1/experiments/{id}:pause (running -> paused; keeps assignment config but stops routing) — confirm with Design

Validation rules
- [x] Route scoping is explicit (project_id + route_id + environment) and consistent with policy engine naming.
- [x] Enforce non-overlap: only one RUNNING experiment per {project_id, route_id, environment} unless explicit override flag present and user has elevated permission.
- [x] Traffic split sums to 100%; supports 2..N variants.
- [x] Variant config includes model_ref + optional runtime config overrides (e.g., quantization profile, max_tokens). Enforce allowlist of override keys for v1.
- [x] Eligibility rules validated (region allowlist, tenant/project, optional header-based bucketing field selection per ADR-0187).
- [x] Start/stop scheduling constraints validated (no start in the past unless ‘start now’).

AuthZ/RBAC
- [x] Create/update/validate requires Console permission: experiments:write.
- [x] Start/stop/rollback requires experiments:operate.
- [x] List/get requires experiments:read.
- [x] Ensure project scoping is enforced (cannot access across org/projects).

Audit logging
- [x] Emit audit log entries per spec on create/update/validate/start/stop/rollback.
- [x] Audit payload includes actor, org_id, project_id, experiment_id, route_id, before/after diff summary, request_id, and timestamp.
- [x] Audit emission is best-effort but non-silent: if audit sink fails, return 500 on lifecycle actions (start/stop/rollback) and 200-with-warning on validate.

Operational behavior
- [x] Idempotency for lifecycle endpoints: repeated :start or :stop calls return 200 with current state.
- [x] Rollback is safe under partial failure: if policy write succeeds but cache invalidation fails, return 202 + warning and enqueue retry.
- [x] API returns stable error codes for UI mapping (EXPERIMENT_CONFLICT, INVALID_CONFIG, PERMISSION_DENIED, AUDIT_FAILED, POLICY_WRITE_FAILED).

Testing
- [x] Unit tests for validation + state machine transitions.
- [x] Integration tests for authz + audit hooks.
- [x] Contract tests against policy engine client (mocked) to verify precedence fields are passed correctly.

Docs
- [x] Add internal README for endpoints + example payloads for Solutions/SRE.
- [ ] Add public-facing API docs (if any) is out of scope; ensure DevEx guide references these semantics (track in DevEx ticket).
implementation_notes:
Data model (DB)
- experiments table
  - id (uuid)
  - org_id, project_id
  - environment (hosted|dedicated; private gated)
  - route_id (string; canonical gateway route key)
  - name
  - status (DRAFT|RUNNING|PAUSED|STOPPED)
  - created_by, updated_by
  - created_at, updated_at
  - started_at, stopped_at
  - schedule_start_at, schedule_end_at (nullable)
  - config_json (stored canonical config)
  - config_version (int) for optimistic concurrency

- experiment_variants table (or embedded JSON)
  - We’re starting with embedded JSON to keep schema flexible, but enforce strict validation/allowlist at the API layer.
  - config_json includes variant_id, display_name, model_ref, runtime_overrides, traffic_percent

State machine
- DRAFT: editable
- RUNNING: not editable except via stop/rollback
- PAUSED: editable? (proposal: allow editing traffic split + runtime overrides while paused only; confirm with PM/Design)
- STOPPED: immutable; can be cloned

Policy engine integration
- On :start, write an experiment policy entry for {project_id, route_id, environment} that routes to variants with weights.
- On :stop, remove experiment policy entry and restore prior policy (canary/pin) if it existed.
- On :rollback, same as stop but with elevated urgency + explicit audit reason.

Concurrency/consistency
- Use config_version optimistic locking on PATCH + lifecycle operations.
- Store a snapshot of prior routing policy (policy_snapshot_json) at start-time to support rollback.

Error handling
- Conflict (409) when an overlapping RUNNING experiment exists.
- Invalid config (400) with field-level errors and warnings.
- Permission denied (403).

Notes on private deployment
- Private env is feature-flagged; reject with 403 (ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED) unless org has entitlement.

comments: 2026-02-06 — Marissa Cole: Please ensure the API returns both errors *and warnings* on validate. We need warnings for overlapping rollouts (canary running) even if we allow it with precedence rules. UI copy depends on this.

2026-02-07 — Marcus Lin: For audit, we need before/after summaries and actor identity (user_id + email) when available. For service-to-service calls (SRE automation), include actor_type=service and service_name. See ab-testing-audit-events spec; do not log raw config fields that can include customer prompt content (should not be in config anyway).

2026-02-09 — Jordan Lee: On :start, make sure we pass ‘assignment_key_strategy’ exactly as ADR-0187 (e.g., api_key_id fallback to tenant_id). This impacts exposure logs joining later; mismatch will cause confusing results.

2026-02-11 — Sean Gallagher: Rollback endpoint must be callable by on-call tooling. Please add support for an explicit ‘reason’ string in the request body and propagate to audit logs. Also ensure it is idempotent and returns quickly even if background cleanup continues.

2026-02-13 — Kenji Nakamura: UI expects a ‘normalized_config’ payload on validate, where traffic_percent is canonicalized and variant display names are returned. Also needs a stable error code so we can highlight the right field.

2026-02-18 — Chloe Martin: Implemented endpoints + validation; PR up for review. Still need to decide whether PAUSED is required for v1 or if stop is sufficient. I added PAUSED in the enum but kept endpoint behind a server flag for now.

2026-02-20 — Dylan Brooks: Strong preference to keep PAUSED for beta; dogfood feedback suggests customers want a way to stop routing while keeping config for later. Please confirm with Marissa + Design and either ship or remove before GA.
